hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; [ -f .code-review-graph/graph.db ] || exit 0; code-review-graph status 2>/dev/null || true; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($root -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $root '.code-review-graph/graph.db'))) { code-review-graph status 2>$null }; exit 0
